dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based, uses MCP linkage area pattern typical of JMA ORCA
evidence: EXEC SQL absent, MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT control flow

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – output selection screen XG04 for medical information system data export
purpose.summary: This program implements the output selection screen (XG04) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles initialization, screen transitions, and data retrieval from the tbl_file_mis table to display a list of file output jobs with their status, date ranges, and processing details. It supports navigation from/to other screens (XG99, XGID1, XG02, XB01) and manages job control for CSV export.

notable_features: EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
SEARCH with VARYING for table lookup
Japanese text in comments and data literals (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
PERFORM UNTIL loop reading tbl_file_mis records
GO TO used for section exits
verdict.notes: Source decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP or Shift-JIS multibyte characters in comments and string literals, appearing as mojibake in the latin-1 rendering. This is normal for JMA ORCA source files. The file is truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 52900 bytes / 1260 lines. Program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system.
